rationale: Each reset source is independently synchronized into the same clock domain before the local reset is formed by an AND; the controlled state sees only that local-domain reset.

mutation.description: Reduced the target reset generator to two local synchronizers followed by same-domain reset conjunction.

provenance.adaptation: Removed I3C bus timing and retained the synchronized reset-combination structure.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Each reset is released through its own synchroniser in the same clock and only the synchronised outputs are ANDed.
